name: LocalNewvector.mem_congruenceK0_iff
statement:
theorem mem_congruenceK0_iff {ϖ : R} {n : ℕ} {x : GL (Fin 2) K} :
    x ∈ congruenceK0 (K := K) ϖ n ↔
      ∃ y : GL (Fin 2) R,
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := Fin 2) (algebraMap R K) y = x ∧
        (y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0 ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ ^ n}

name: LocalNewvector.mem_congruenceK1_iff
statement:
theorem mem_congruenceK1_iff {ϖ : R} {n : ℕ} {x : GL (Fin 2) K} :
    x ∈ congruenceK1 (K := K) ϖ n ↔
      ∃ y : GL (Fin 2) R,
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := Fin 2) (algebraMap R K) y = x ∧
        (y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0 ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ ^ n} ∧
        (y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 1 - 1 ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ ^ n}

statement:
theorem H1.map_mk (S : Set (Place K F)) (T : Set (Place K F')) (φ : F →ₐ[K] F')

    (hcompat : eRel s x' f e he ≫ repAct s G x' hX' = (canonical s f).act ≫ e.hom)

    (hg : g₁ ≫ pullback.fst T.hom s = g₂ ≫ pullback.fst T.hom s) :
    g₁ ≫ (leftHom s x' (hX'.homEquiv.symm (G.map (coverT s T).op z)) ≫ e.inv ≫ pullback.fst f s) =
      g₂ ≫ (leftHom s x' (hX'.homEquiv.symm (G.map (coverT s T).op z)) ≫ e.inv ≫ pullback.fst f s)

FppfCohomologyLES.cohomologyLES_iso_compatible
statement:
theorem cohomologyLES_iso_compatible {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})}
    (hS₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (hS₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (e : S₁ ≅ S₂) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₀) ∧
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₂ n₀) ∧
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₂ n₀ (cohomologyMap S₁.f n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap S₂.f n₀ (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀ (cohomologyMap S₁.g n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap S₂.g n₀ (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₂ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyδ hS₂ n₀ n₁ h (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₁ (cohomologyδ hS₁ n₀ n₁ h x))

name: FppfCohomologyLES.cohomologyLES_ladder
statement:
theorem cohomologyLES_ladder {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})}
    (hS₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (hS₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    (∀ x, cohomologyMap φ.τ₂ n₀ (cohomologyMap S₁.f n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap S₂.f n₀ (cohomologyMap φ.τ₁ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyMap φ.τ₃ n₀ (cohomologyMap S₁.g n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap S₂.g n₀ (cohomologyMap φ.τ₂ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyδ hS₂ n₀ n₁ h (cohomologyMap φ.τ₃ n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap φ.τ₁ n₁ (cohomologyδ hS₁ n₀ n₁ h x))

name: FppfCohomologyLES.cohomology_naturality_g
statement:
theorem cohomology_naturality_g {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})}

    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₀) ∧
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₂ n₀) ∧
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀) ∧

        cohomologyMap S₂.f n₀ (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀ (cohomologyMap S₁.g n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap S₂.g n₀ (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₂ n₀ x)) ∧
    (∀ x, cohomologyδ hS₂ n₀ n₁ h (cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₃ n₀ x) =
        cohomologyMap e.hom.τ₁ n₁ (cohomologyδ hS₁ n₀ n₁ h x))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallExtension.tensorToDualHom_tmul

    tensorToDualHom k M W (m ⊗ₜ w) ξ = ξ w • m

      ((y : (FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K)ˣ))⁻¹ * (y' : (FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K)ˣ) ∈

    (hα0 : α ≠ 0) (hα1 : α - 1 ∈ 𝔣)
    (hy : ((y : (FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K)ˣ) : FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K) =
      ((Ideal.span {α} : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K))
    (hα0' : α' ≠ 0) (hα1' : α' - 1 ∈ 𝔣)
    (hy' : ((y' : (FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K)ˣ) : FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K) =
      ((Ideal.span {α'} : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : FractionalIdeal ((𝓞 K)⁰) K))
    (hsgn : ∀ τ : K →+* ℝ,
      (0 < τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K α)) ↔ (0 < τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K α'))) :
    NarrowRayClassGroup.mk K 𝔣 y = NarrowRayClassGroup.mk K 𝔣 y'

      (0 < τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K α)) ↔ (0 < τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K α'))) :

      narrowRaySet K 𝔣

theorem boundedToL2_add {D : Set ℍ} (hD : volume D < ∞) (hDm : MeasurableSet D)
    (f g : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (C C' : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ D, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) (hC' : ∀ z ∈ D, ‖g z‖ ≤ C') :
    boundedToL2 hD hDm (f + g) (hf.add hg) (C + C')
        (fun z hz => (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC z hz) (hC' z hz))) =
      boundedToL2 hD hDm f hf C hC + boundedToL2 hD hDm g hg C' hC'

name: AutomorphicForm.rightConv_apply
statement:
theorem rightConv_apply (φ f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) → ℂ)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K)) :
    rightConv K φ f g =
      (letI := AdelicHaar.glBorel (Fin 2) (𝓞 K) K
       ∫ x, φ (g * x) * f x ∂(AdelicHaar.adelicGLHaar (Fin 2) (𝓞 K) K))

name: AutomorphicForm.rightConv_comp_mul_left
statement:
theorem rightConv_comp_mul_left (φ f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) → ℂ)
    (h g : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K)) :
    rightConv K (fun x => φ (h * x)) f g = rightConv K φ f (h * g)

statement:
theorem rightConv_zero_left (f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) → ℂ) :

theorem rightConv_zero_right (φ : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) → ℂ) :

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.coe_map
statement:
theorem coe_map (φ : K →+* L) (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map φ g : GL (Fin 2) L) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) L)
      = (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).map φ

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.det_upper_entries_mul
statement:
theorem det_upper_entries_mul {s : GL (Fin 2) K} {a t : K}
    (h00 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 0 = a)
    (h10 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0 = 0)
    (h11 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 1 = t)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    ((s * g : GL (Fin 2) K) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).det
      = a * t * (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).det

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.localHeight_map
statement:
theorem localHeight_map (φ : K →+* L) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖) (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    localHeight (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map φ g) = localHeight g

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.localHeight_mul_mul_localHeight_le
statement:
theorem localHeight_mul_mul_localHeight_le (γ g : GL (Fin 2) K)
    (hγ : (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0 ≠ 0) :
    localHeight (γ * g) * localHeight g
      ≤ ‖(γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).det‖ / ‖(γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0‖ ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.localHeight_upper_entries_mul
statement:
theorem localHeight_upper_entries_mul {s : GL (Fin 2) K} {a t : K} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (h00 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 0 = a)
    (h10 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0 = 0)
    (h11 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 1 = t)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    localHeight (s * g) = ‖a‖ / ‖t‖ * localHeight g

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.map_upperUnit
statement:
theorem map_upperUnit (φ : K →+* L) (a b t : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map φ (upperUnit a b t ha ht)
      = upperUnit (φ a) (φ b) (φ t) ((map_ne_zero φ).2 ha) ((map_ne_zero φ).2 ht)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.norm_det_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_det_sq_le (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) :
    ‖M.det‖ ^ 2 ≤ topNormSq M * rowNormSq M

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.norm_extensionEmbedding
statement:
theorem norm_extensionEmbedding (w : InfinitePlace F) (x : w.Completion) :
    ‖InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding w x‖ = ‖x‖

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.ofReal_rowNormSq
statement:
theorem ofReal_rowNormSq (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ((rowNormSq g : ℝ) : ℂ) = g 1 0 * conj (g 1 0) + g 1 1 * conj (g 1 1)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.rowNormSq_map
statement:
theorem rowNormSq_map (φ : K →+* L) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) :
    rowNormSq (M.map φ) = rowNormSq M

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.sq_mul_sq_le_rowNormSq_mul
statement:
theorem sq_mul_sq_le_rowNormSq_mul (γ g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    ‖(γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0‖ ^ 2 * ‖(g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).det‖ ^ 2
      ≤ rowNormSq ((γ * g : GL (Fin 2) K) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) *
          rowNormSq (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.topNormSq_map
statement:
theorem topNormSq_map (φ : K →+* L) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) :
    topNormSq (M.map φ) = topNormSq M

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.topNormSq_mul_rowNormSq
statement:
theorem topNormSq_mul_rowNormSq (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    topNormSq g * rowNormSq g = ‖g 0 0 * conj (g 1 0) + g 0 1 * conj (g 1 1)‖ ^ 2 + ‖g.det‖ ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.upperUnit_apply_one_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperUnit_apply_one_one (a b t : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (upperUnit a b t ha ht : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 1 = t

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.upperUnit_apply_one_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperUnit_apply_one_zero (a b t : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.upperUnit_apply_zero_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperUnit_apply_zero_one (a b t : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (upperUnit a b t ha ht : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 1 = b

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.upperUnit_apply_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperUnit_apply_zero_zero (a b t : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (upperUnit a b t ha ht : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 0 = a

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xCoord_upper_entries_mul
statement:
theorem xCoord_upper_entries_mul {s : GL (Fin 2) ℂ} {a b t : ℂ} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (h00 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0 = a)
    (h01 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1 = b)
    (h10 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 0 = 0)
    (h11 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 1 = t)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    xCoord ((s * g : GL (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      = a / t * xCoord (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) + b / t

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xWindowSq_diag_entries_mul
statement:
theorem xWindowSq_diag_entries_mul {s : GL (Fin 2) K} {a t : K} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (h00 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 0 = a)
    (h01 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 0 1 = 0)
    (h10 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 0 = 0)
    (h11 : (s : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) 1 1 = t)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    xWindowSq (s * g) = (‖a‖ / ‖t‖) ^ 2 * xWindowSq g

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xWindowSq_eq_norm_xCoord_map_sq
statement:
theorem xWindowSq_eq_norm_xCoord_map_sq (φ : K →+* ℂ) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖) (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    xWindowSq g = ‖xCoord ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).map φ)‖ ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xWindowSq_eq_norm_xCoord_sq
statement:
theorem xWindowSq_eq_norm_xCoord_sq (g : GL (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    xWindowSq g = ‖xCoord (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)‖ ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xWindowSq_map
statement:
theorem xWindowSq_map (φ : K →+* L) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖) (g : GL (Fin 2) K) :
    xWindowSq (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map φ g) = xWindowSq g

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelCoordinates.xWindowSq_nonneg
statement: theorem xWindowSq_nonneg (g : GL (Fin 2) K) : 0 ≤ xWindowSq g

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.abs_norm_eq_one_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem abs_norm_eq_one_of_mem_range {x : F} (hx : x ∈ (algebraMap (𝓞 F) F).range)
    (hx' : x⁻¹ ∈ (algebraMap (𝓞 F) F).range) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) : |Algebra.norm ℚ x| = 1

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.archComponent_globalPoints_apply
statement:
theorem archComponent_globalPoints_apply (w : InfinitePlace F) (γ : GL (Fin 2) F) (i j : Fin 2) :
    ((archComponent F w (glArch (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ)) : GL (Fin 2) w.Completion) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) w.Completion) i j
      = ((γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) i j : w.Completion)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.archHeight_globalPoints_mul_mul_archHeight_le
statement:
theorem archHeight_globalPoints_mul_mul_archHeight_le (γ : GL (Fin 2) F)
    (hγ : (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) 1 0 ≠ 0) (h : GL (Fin 2) (InfiniteAdeleRing F)) :
    archHeight F (glArch (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ) * h) * archHeight F h
      ≤ |(Algebra.norm ℚ ((γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F).det) : ℝ)|
          / |(Algebra.norm ℚ ((γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) 1 0) : ℝ)| ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.archHeight_mul_mul_archHeight_le_one
statement:
theorem archHeight_mul_mul_archHeight_le_one (γ : GL (Fin 2) F)
    (hγ : (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) 1 0 ≠ 0) (g : AdelicGL2 (𝓞 F) F)
    (hg : glFin (𝓞 F) F g ∈ finiteIntegralGL2 (𝓞 F) F)
    (hγg : glFin (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ * g) ∈ finiteIntegralGL2 (𝓞 F) F) :
    archHeight F (glArch (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ * g)) * archHeight F (glArch (𝓞 F) F g)
      ≤ 1

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.det_archComponent_globalPoints
statement:
theorem det_archComponent_globalPoints (w : InfinitePlace F) (γ : GL (Fin 2) F) :
    ((archComponent F w (glArch (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ)) : GL (Fin 2) w.Completion) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) w.Completion).det
      = ((γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F).det : w.Completion)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.glFin_globalPoints_apply
statement:
theorem glFin_globalPoints_apply (γ : GL (Fin 2) F) (i j : Fin 2) :
    ((glFin (𝓞 F) F (globalPoints (𝓞 F) F γ) : GL (Fin 2) (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)) i j
      = algebraMap F (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) ((γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) i j)

name: AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.mem_range_of_coe_mem_integralFiniteAdeles
AutomorphicForm.SiegelReduction.mem_range_of_glFin_globalPoints_mem
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_glFin_globalPoints_mem {γ : GL (Fin 2) F}

LT.LatticeTree.dvd_of_isFixedVertex_interLattice
statement:
theorem dvd_of_isFixedVertex_interLattice [IsDomain R]
    (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)
    {ϖ c d : R} (hϖ : Prime ϖ) (hcd : ¬(ϖ ∣ c ∧ ϖ ∣ d))
    (hcd' : ¬(ϖ ∣ mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 0 ∧
      ϖ ∣ mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 1))
    {hL : IsFullLattice (interLattice R K ϖ c d)}
    (h : IsFixedVertex (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap R K) M)
      (Vertex.mk R K (interLattice R K ϖ c d) hL)) :
    ϖ ∣ d * mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 0 -
      c * mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 1

    (h : latticeMap (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap R K) M)
        (interLattice R K ϖ c d) = interLattice R K ϖ c d) :
    ϖ ∣ d * mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 0 -
      c * mulVecPair (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) c d 1

name: LT.LatticeTree.dvd_of_twistedLatticeMap_map_interLattice_eq_self
statement:
theorem dvd_of_twistedLatticeMap_map_interLattice_eq_self [IsFractionRing R K]
    (δ : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) R) (σ : IntegralAut R K) {ϖ : R}
    (hϖ : σ.toBase ϖ = ϖ) {c d : R}
    (h : twistedLatticeMap (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap R K) δ) σ
        (interLattice R K ϖ c d) = interLattice R K ϖ c d) :
    ϖ ∣ d * mulVecPair (δ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (σ.toBase c) (σ.toBase d) 0 -
        c * mulVecPair (δ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (σ.toBase c) (σ.toBase d) 1

name: LT.LatticeTree.twistedUnitOrbitalCount_refl

name: LT.LatticeTree.unitOfNeZero_coe

name: LT.LatticeTree.unitOrbitalCount_conj

name: CerednikDrinfeld.BruhatTits.pgl_mk_smul

name: CerednikDrinfeld.BruhatTits.scalar_eq_scalarGL

name: CerednikDrinfeld.BruhatTits.tree_adj_iff

theorem tree_adj_iff (x y : Vertex R K) :

name: CerednikDrinfeld.BruhatTits.vertPermHom_apply

name: CerednikDrinfeld.FormalOmega.isUnit_pow_pred_sub_one_of_isUnit_pow_sub
statement:

name: CerednikDrinfeld.FormalOmega.isUnit_pow_succ_sub_one_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isUnit_pow_succ_sub_one_of_isNilpotent {B : Type} [CommRing B] {a : B} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (b : B) (n : ℕ) :

name: CerednikDrinfeld.FormalOmega.vertexToEdge_natural
statement:
theorem vertexToEdge_natural (π : 𝒪) {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra 𝒪 B] {B' : Type} [CommRing B']
    [Algebra 𝒪 B'] (hB : IsNilpotent (algebraMap 𝒪 B π)) (hB' : IsNilpotent (algebraMap 𝒪 B' π)) (f : B →ₐ[𝒪] B')
    (x : (chartVUnit 𝒪 q).obj B) :
    (chartE 𝒪 π q).map f (vertexToEdge π hq B hB x) = vertexToEdge π hq B' hB' ((chartVUnit 𝒪 q).map f x)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.FormalOmega.AlgFunctor.const_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem const_map (X : Type) {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra 𝒪 B] {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] [Algebra 𝒪 B']
    (φ : B →ₐ[𝒪] B') (x : X) : (const (𝒪 := 𝒪) X).map φ x = x

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.beta_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem beta_apply (V Pi : M →+ M) (m : M) : beta V Pi m = (V m, -Pi m)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.beta_range_le_ker_coprod
statement:
theorem beta_range_le_ker_coprod (V Pi : M →+ M) (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) :
    (beta V Pi).range ≤ (Pi.coprod V).ker

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.beta_range_le_ker_phi
statement:
theorem beta_range_le_ker_phi (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) :
    (beta V Pi).range ≤ (L.coprod (inl V Pi)).ker

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.beta_range_le_ker_toLie
statement:
theorem beta_range_le_ker_toLie (V Pi : M →+ M) :
    (beta V Pi).range ≤ ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' V.range).comp (AddMonoidHom.fst M M)).ker

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_V_zero
statement: theorem cls_V_zero (V Pi : M →+ M) (m : M) : cls V Pi (V m) 0 = cls V Pi 0 (Pi m)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_add_cls
statement:
theorem cls_add_cls (V Pi : M →+ M) (m m' n n' : M) :
    cls V Pi m m' + cls V Pi n n' = cls V Pi (m + n) (m' + n')

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_beta
statement: @[simp] theorem cls_beta (V Pi : M →+ M) (m : M) : cls V Pi (V m) (-Pi m) = 0

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_eq_inl_add_iota
statement:
theorem cls_eq_inl_add_iota (V Pi : M →+ M) (m m' : M) :
    cls V Pi m m' = inl V Pi m + iota V Pi m'

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_mem_piece
statement:
theorem cls_mem_piece (V Pi : M →+ M) {A A' : AddSubgroup M} {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ A)
    (hm' : m' ∈ A') : cls V Pi m m' ∈ piece V Pi A A'

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_surjective
statement: theorem cls_surjective (V Pi : M →+ M) (z : NMod V Pi) : ∃ m m' : M, cls V Pi m m' = z

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.cls_zero_zero
statement: theorem cls_zero_zero (V Pi : M →+ M) : cls V Pi 0 0 = 0

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.inl_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem inl_apply (V Pi : M →+ M) (m : M) : inl V Pi m = cls V Pi m 0

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.inl_comp_V
statement: theorem inl_comp_V (V Pi : M →+ M) : (inl V Pi).comp V = (iota V Pi).comp Pi

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.iota_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem iota_apply (V Pi : M →+ M) (m : M) : iota V Pi m = cls V Pi 0 m

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.lambda_cls
statement:
@[simp] theorem lambda_cls (V Pi : M →+ M) (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) (m m' : M) :
    lambda V Pi h (cls V Pi m m') = Pi m + V m'

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.lambda_comp_inl
statement:
theorem lambda_comp_inl (V Pi : M →+ M) (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) :
    (lambda V Pi h).comp (inl V Pi) = Pi

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.lambda_comp_iota
statement:
theorem lambda_comp_iota (V Pi : M →+ M) (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) :
    (lambda V Pi h).comp (iota V Pi) = V

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.lambda_comp_map
statement:
theorem lambda_comp_map (V Pi : M →+ M) (V' Pi' : M' →+ M') (T : M →+ M')
    (hV : T.comp V = V'.comp T) (hPi : T.comp Pi = Pi'.comp T)
    (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) (h' : Pi'.comp V' = V'.comp Pi') :
    (lambda V' Pi' h').comp (map V Pi V' Pi' T hV hPi) = T.comp (lambda V Pi h)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.lambda_mk
statement:
theorem lambda_mk (V Pi : M →+ M) (h : Pi.comp V = V.comp Pi) (x : M × M) :
    lambda V Pi h (mk V Pi x) = Pi x.1 + V x.2

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.map
statement:
def map (V Pi : M →+ M) (V' Pi' : M' →+ M') (T : M →+ M')
    (hV : T.comp V = V'.comp T) (hPi : T.comp Pi = Pi'.comp T) : NMod V Pi →+ NMod V' Pi'

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.map_cls
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_cls (V Pi : M →+ M) (V' Pi' : M' →+ M') (T : M →+ M')
    (hV : T.comp V = V'.comp T) (hPi : T.comp Pi = Pi'.comp T) (m m' : M) :
    map V Pi V' Pi' T hV hPi (cls V Pi m m') = cls V' Pi' (T m) (T m')

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mem_eta_iff
statement:
theorem mem_eta_iff (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) (z : NMod V Pi) :
    z ∈ eta V Pi L hL ↔ phi V Pi L hL z = z

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mem_piece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_piece_iff (V Pi : M →+ M) (A A' : AddSubgroup M) (z : NMod V Pi) :
    z ∈ piece V Pi A A' ↔ ∃ m ∈ A, ∃ m' ∈ A', cls V Pi m m' = z

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mk_apply
statement: theorem mk_apply (V Pi : M →+ M) (x : M × M) : mk V Pi x = (x : NMod V Pi)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (V Pi : M →+ M) (x y : M × M) :
    mk V Pi x = mk V Pi y ↔ ∃ m : M, y = x + (V m, -Pi m)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (V Pi : M →+ M) (x : M × M) :
    mk V Pi x = 0 ↔ ∃ m : M, (V m, -Pi m) = x

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective (V Pi : M →+ M) : Function.Surjective (mk V Pi)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.phi_cls
statement:
@[simp] theorem phi_cls (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) (m m' : M) :
    phi V Pi L hL (cls V Pi m m') = L m + cls V Pi m' 0

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.phi_inl
statement:
theorem phi_inl (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) (m : M) : phi V Pi L hL (inl V Pi m) = L m

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.phi_iota
statement:
theorem phi_iota (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) (m : M) : phi V Pi L hL (iota V Pi m) = inl V Pi m

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.toLie_cls
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLie_cls (V Pi : M →+ M) (m m' : M) :
    toLie V Pi (cls V Pi m m') = (m : M ⧸ V.range)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.toLie_comp_iota
statement: theorem toLie_comp_iota (V Pi : M →+ M) : (toLie V Pi).comp (iota V Pi) = 0

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.toLie_comp_map
statement:
theorem toLie_comp_map (V Pi : M →+ M) (V' Pi' : M' →+ M') (T : M →+ M')
    (hV : T.comp V = V'.comp T) (hPi : T.comp Pi = Pi'.comp T) :
    (toLie V' Pi').comp (map V Pi V' Pi' T hV hPi) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.map V.range V'.range T (by
        rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨T m, (DFunLike.congr_fun hV m).symm⟩)).comp (toLie V Pi)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.toLie_surjective
statement: theorem toLie_surjective (V Pi : M →+ M) : Function.Surjective (toLie V Pi)

name: CerednikDrinfeld.CartierN.u_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem u_apply (V Pi : M →+ M) (L : M →+ NMod V Pi)
    (hL : L.comp V = (inl V Pi).comp Pi) (z : eta V Pi L hL) :
    u V Pi L hL z = toLie V Pi (z : NMod V Pi)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.isQuadraticDatum_iff

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mul_star_eq_coe_nrd

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem nrd_coe (r : R) : nrd ((r : R) : ℍ[R, a, b]) = r ^ 2

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem nrd_mk (x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃ : R) :
    nrd (⟨x₀, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ : ℍ[R, a, b]) = x₀ ^ 2 - a * x₁ ^ 2 - b * x₂ ^ 2 + a * b * x₃ ^ 2

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem nrd_neg (x : ℍ[R, a, b]) : nrd (-x) = nrd x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_one
statement: @[simp] theorem nrd_one : nrd (1 : ℍ[R, a, b]) = 1

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_star
statement: @[simp] theorem nrd_star (x : ℍ[R, a, b]) : nrd (star x) = nrd x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.nrd_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem nrd_zero : nrd (0 : ℍ[R, a, b]) = 0

name: QuaternionAlgebra.star_mul_eq_coe_nrd
statement: theorem star_mul_eq_coe_nrd (x : ℍ[R, a, b]) : star x * x = ((nrd x : R) : ℍ[R, a, b])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.trd_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem trd_mk (x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃ : R) :
    trd (⟨x₀, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ : ℍ[R, a, b]) = 2 * x₀

name: Submodule.mem_conjByFiniteIdele_iff
statement:
theorem mem_conjByFiniteIdele_iff (Λ : Submodule ℤ D) (g : (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ)
    (z : D) :
    z ∈ conjByFiniteIdele Λ g ↔
      z ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) ∈
        (finiteAdeleBox Λ).map
          ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight ((g⁻¹ : (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
              D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)).comp
            (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (g : D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)))

name: Submodule.mem_finiteIdeleStabilizer_iff
statement:
theorem mem_finiteIdeleStabilizer_iff (Λ : Submodule ℤ D) (u : (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
    u ∈ finiteIdeleStabilizer Λ ↔
      u • ((finiteAdeleBox Λ : AddSubgroup (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)) :
          Set (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ))
        = ((finiteAdeleBox Λ : AddSubgroup (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)) :
          Set (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ))

name: Submodule.mem_ofFiniteIdele_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ofFiniteIdele_iff (Λ : Submodule ℤ D) (g : (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ)
    (z : D) :
    z ∈ ofFiniteIdele Λ g ↔
      z ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) ∈
        (finiteAdeleBox Λ).map (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (g : D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ))

name: Submodule.val_finiteIdeleDiagonal_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem val_finiteIdeleDiagonal_apply (d : Dˣ) :
    ((finiteIdeleDiagonal D d : (D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
      D ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) = (d : D) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.heckeKernel_mk
statement:
theorem heckeKernel_mk (U : Subgroup (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ)
    (S : Set (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ)
    (hS : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ s ∈ S, u * s ∈ S)
    (x : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) (y : ClassSet U) :
    heckeKernel U S (ClassSet.mk U x) y = Nat.card (HeckeIncidence U S x y)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mem_congruenceLevel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_congruenceLevel_iff (Λ P : Submodule ℤ ℍ[ℚ, a, b])
    (u : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
    u ∈ congruenceLevel Λ P ↔
      u ∈ Submodule.finiteIdeleStabilizer Λ ∧ u ∈ Submodule.finiteIdeleStabilizer P ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox Λ,
          (u : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) * x - x ∈ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox P

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mem_levelHeckeSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_levelHeckeSet_iff (Λ P : Submodule ℤ ℍ[ℚ, a, b]) (ℓ : ℕ)
    (h : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
    h ∈ levelHeckeSet Λ P ℓ ↔
      h ∈ primeHeckeSet Λ ℓ ∧
        (h : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) - 1 ∈ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox P

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mem_primeHeckeSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_primeHeckeSet_iff (Λ : Submodule ℤ ℍ[ℚ, a, b]) (ℓ : ℕ)
    (h : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
    h ∈ primeHeckeSet Λ ℓ ↔
      (h : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) ∈ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox Λ ∧
      (ℓ : ℚ) • ((h⁻¹ : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) :
          ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) ∈ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox Λ ∧
      ((h⁻¹ : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)ˣ) : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ)
          ∉ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox Λ ∧
      (ℓ : ℚ)⁻¹ • (h : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) ∉ Submodule.finiteAdeleBox Λ

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mul_mul_mem_normIdeal
QuaternionAlgebra.mem_localEmbeddingSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_localEmbeddingSet_iff (Λ : Submodule ℤ ℍ[ℚ, a, b]) (α : ℍ[ℚ, a, b])
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 ℚ)) (β : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ)ˣ) :
    β ∈ localEmbeddingSet Λ α v ↔
      ∀ y ∈ localQuadSubring α v,
        ((β⁻¹ : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ)ˣ) : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ) * y * β
            ∈ (Submodule.localBox Λ v : Set (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ))
          ↔ y ∈ (Submodule.localBox Λ v : Set (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ))

name: QuaternionAlgebra.mem_localQuadUnits_iff
statement:
theorem mem_localQuadUnits_iff (α : ℍ[ℚ, a, b]) (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 ℚ))
    (u : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ)ˣ) :
    u ∈ localQuadUnits α v ↔
      (u : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ) ∈ localQuadSubring α v ∧
        ((u⁻¹ : (ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ)ˣ) : ℍ[ℚ, a, b] ⊗[ℚ] v.adicCompletion ℚ)
          ∈ localQuadSubring α v

name: Submodule.mem_localBoxUnits_iff

statement:
theorem walkOverlap_append_left {u v w u' v' : W} (P₁ : 𝒯.Walk u v) (P₂ : 𝒯.Walk v w) (Q : 𝒯.Walk u' v') :
    walkOverlap (P₁.append P₂) Q = walkOverlap P₁ Q + walkOverlap P₂ Q

name: CerednikDrinfeld.Mumford.walkOverlap_append_right
statement:
theorem walkOverlap_append_right {u v u' v' w' : W} (P : 𝒯.Walk u v) (Q₁ : 𝒯.Walk u' v') (Q₂ : 𝒯.Walk v' w') :
    walkOverlap P (Q₁.append Q₂) = walkOverlap P Q₁ + walkOverlap P Q₂

name: CerednikDrinfeld.Mumford.walkOverlap_cons_left
statement:
theorem walkOverlap_cons_left {u v w u' v' : W} (h : 𝒯.Adj u v) (P : 𝒯.Walk v w) (Q : 𝒯.Walk u' v') :
    walkOverlap (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h P) Q =
      (((Q.darts.count ⟨(u, v), h⟩ : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((Q.darts.count (⟨(u, v), h⟩ : 𝒯.Dart).symm : ℕ) : ℤ)) +
        walkOverlap P Q

name: CerednikDrinfeld.Mumford.walkOverlap_eq_sum
statement:
theorem walkOverlap_eq_sum {u v u' v' : W} (P : 𝒯.Walk u v) (Q : 𝒯.Walk u' v') :
    walkOverlap P Q = (P.darts.map fun d => ((Q.darts.count d : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((Q.darts.count d.symm : ℕ) : ℤ)).sum

name: CerednikDrinfeld.Mumford.walkOverlap_map

    walkOverlap (P.map f) (Q.map f) = walkOverlap P Q

name: ClassFunction.induced_add
statement:
theorem induced_add (H : Subgroup G) (φ ψ : G → K) :
    induced H (φ + ψ) = induced H φ + induced H ψ

name: ClassFunction.induced_apply
statement:
theorem induced_apply (H : Subgroup G) [DecidablePred (· ∈ H)] (φ : G → K) (g : G) :
    induced H φ g =
      (Nat.card H : K)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G, if x⁻¹ * g * x ∈ H then φ (x⁻¹ * g * x) else 0

name: ClassFunction.induced_congr
statement:
theorem induced_congr (H : Subgroup G) {φ ψ : G → K} (h : ∀ x ∈ H, φ x = ψ x) :
    induced H φ = induced H ψ

name: ClassFunction.induced_const_mul
statement:
theorem induced_const_mul (H : Subgroup G) (c : K) (φ : G → K) :
    induced H (fun x => c * φ x) = fun g => c * induced H φ g

name: ClassFunction.induced_induced
statement:
theorem induced_induced [CharZero K] (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] [DecidablePred (· ∈ H)]
    (L : Subgroup H) (ψ : H → K) :
    induced H (fun g => if hg : g ∈ H then induced L ψ ⟨g, hg⟩ else 0) =
      induced (L.map H.subtype) (fun g => if hg : g ∈ H then ψ ⟨g, hg⟩ else 0)

name: ClassFunction.induced_mul_of_conj_invariant
statement:
theorem induced_mul_of_conj_invariant (H : Subgroup G) (φ f : G → K)
    (hf : ∀ x g : G, f (x⁻¹ * g * x) = f g) (g : G) :
    induced H φ g * f g = induced H (fun y => φ y * f y) g

name: ClassFunction.induced_sum
statement:
theorem induced_sum {ι : Type*} (H : Subgroup G) (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G → K) :
    induced H (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, φ i x) = fun g => ∑ i ∈ s, induced H (φ i) g

name: ClassFunction.induced_top_of_conj_invariant
statement:
theorem induced_top_of_conj_invariant [CharZero K] (φ : G → K)
    (hφ : ∀ x g : G, φ (x⁻¹ * g * x) = φ g) : induced (⊤ : Subgroup G) φ = φ

      = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ ((c h : Λ₂) : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) * β) :

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.cvn_lintegral
statement:
theorem cvn_lintegral (β : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (c : Λ₁ ≃ Λ₂)
    (hc : ∀ h : Λ₁, β * (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ (h : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
      = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ ((c h : Λ₂) : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) * β)
    (U : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) (hU : Measurable U) (hUinv : ∀ h ∈ Λ₂, ∀ x : ℍ, U (h • x) = U x) :
    ∫⁻ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), ∑ q : SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ₁, U (β • (q.out⁻¹ : SL(2, ℤ)) • x)
      = ∫⁻ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), ∑ q : SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ₂, U ((q.out⁻¹ : SL(2, ℤ)) • x)

statement:
theorem integrable_cosum {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hFc : Continuous F) (hGc : Continuous G)
    (hFb : ∃ C, ∀ x, dens k F x ≤ C) (hGb : ∃ C, ∀ x, dens k G x ≤ C) (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    Integrable (cosum Λ g (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k F G)) (volume.restrict (𝒟 : Set ℍ))

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.integral_cosum_pair
statement:
theorem integral_cosum_pair {Λ₁ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} [Fintype (SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ₁)] (β : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (c : Λ₁ ≃ Λ)
    (hc : ∀ h : Λ₁,
      β * (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ (h : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
        = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ ((c h : Λ) : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) * β)
    {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : Nice Λ k F) (hG : Nice Λ k G) :
    ∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ₁ β (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k F G) x
      = ∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ 1 (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k F G) x

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.integral_cosum_polar
statement:
theorem integral_cosum_polar (Λ' : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)) [Fintype (SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ')]
    (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : Nice Λ k F) (hG : Nice Λ k G) :
    ∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ' g (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k F G) x
      = (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ' g (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G + F) (G + F)) x)
        + Complex.I * (∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ' g
            (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G + Complex.I • F) (G + Complex.I • F)) x)
        - (∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ' g (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G - F) (G - F)) x)
        - Complex.I * (∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ' g
            (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G - Complex.I • F) (G - Complex.I • F)) x))

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.integral_cosum_self
statement:
theorem integral_cosum_self {Λ₁ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} [Fintype (SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ₁)] (β : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (c : Λ₁ ≃ Λ)
    (hc : ∀ h : Λ₁,
      β * (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ (h : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
        = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ ((c h : Λ) : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) * β)
    {H : ℍ → ℂ} (hH : Nice Λ k H) :
    ∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ₁ β (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k H H) x
      = ∫ x in (𝒟 : Set ℍ), cosum Λ 1 (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k H H) x

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.pair_slash
statement:
theorem pair_slash {Λ₁ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} [Fintype (SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ₁)] (β : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 < (β.det : ℝ)) (c : Λ₁ ≃ Λ)
    (hc : ∀ h : Λ₁,
      β * (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ (h : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
        = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ ((c h : Λ) : SL(2, ℤ)) : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) * β)
    {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : Nice Λ k F) (hG : Nice Λ k G) :
    pair Λ₁ k (F ∣[k] β) (G ∣[k] β) = ((β.det : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (k - 2) * pair Λ k F G

theorem pair_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℍ → ℂ) (G : ℍ → ℂ)

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.petersson_polarization
statement:
theorem petersson_polarization (F G : ℍ → ℂ) (x : ℍ) :
    UpperHalfPlane.petersson k F G x
      = (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G + F) (G + F) x
          + Complex.I * UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G + Complex.I • F) (G + Complex.I • F) x
          - UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G - F) (G - F) x
          - Complex.I * UpperHalfPlane.petersson k (G - Complex.I • F) (G - Complex.I • F) x)

name: CuspForm.PeterssonCoset.tsum_G_eq
statement:
theorem tsum_G_eq (U w : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) (hUinv : ∀ h ∈ Λ, ∀ x : ℍ, U (h • x) = U x) (x : ℍ)
    (hwt : ∀ q : SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ, ∑' h : Λ, w ((h : SL(2, ℤ)) • (q.out⁻¹ : SL(2, ℤ)) • x) = 2) :
    ∑' σ : SL(2, ℤ), U (σ • x) * w (σ • x)
      = 2 * ∑ q : SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Λ, U ((q.out⁻¹ : SL(2, ℤ)) • x)

statement: theorem of_injective : Function.Injective (AdjoinRoot.of (cyclotomic N ℤ))

name: Deformation.matrixRepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma matrixRepresentation_apply (ρ : G →* GL n k) (g : G) :
    matrixRepresentation ρ g = Matrix.mulVecLin (ρ g).val

name: TaylorWiles.adAction_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma adAction_apply (M X : M₂ k) : adAction M X = M * X - X * M

statement: @[simp] lemma mem_traceZero_iff {X : M₂ k} : X ∈ traceZero k ↔ X.trace = 0

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_frobeniusFun
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_frobeniusFun (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin n) :
    (frobeniusFun x).coeff i = x.coeff i ^ p

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_map (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin n) :
    (map f x).coeff i = f (x.coeff i)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_shift_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_shift_succ (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin n) :
    (shift x).coeff i.succ = x.coeff i

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_shift_zero
statement: theorem coeff_shift_zero (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) : (shift x).coeff 0 = 0

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_verschiebung_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_verschiebung_succ (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < n) :
    (verschiebung x).coeff ⟨i + 1, hi⟩ = x.coeff ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_verschiebung_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_verschiebung_zero (x : TruncatedWittVector p (n + 1) R) :
    (verschiebung x).coeff 0 = 0

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_add
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_add (hR : (p : R) = 0) (x y : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    frobeniusFun (x + y) = frobeniusFun x + frobeniusFun y

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_shift
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_shift (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    frobeniusFun (shift x) = shift (frobeniusFun x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_truncate
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_truncate [CharP R p] (x : WittVector p R) :
    frobeniusFun (WittVector.truncate n x) = WittVector.truncate n (WittVector.frobenius x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_truncateLE
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_truncateLE {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p m R) :
    frobeniusFun (TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm x) =
      TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm (frobeniusFun x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_verschiebung
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_verschiebung (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    frobeniusFun (verschiebung x) = verschiebung (frobeniusFun x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_verschiebung_eq_smul
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_verschiebung_eq_smul (hR : (p : R) = 0) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    frobeniusFun (verschiebung x) = (p : ℤ) • x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_zero
statement: theorem frobeniusFun_zero : frobeniusFun (0 : TruncatedWittVector p n R) = 0

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    (map (p := p) (n := n) g).comp (map f) = map (g.comp f)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_congr
statement:
theorem map_congr {f g : R →+* S} {x : TruncatedWittVector p n R}
    (h : ∀ i, f (x.coeff i) = g (x.coeff i)) : map f x = map g x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_frobeniusFun
statement:
theorem map_frobeniusFun (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    map f (frobeniusFun x) = frobeniusFun (map f x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map_id (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) : map (RingHom.id R) x = x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Injective f) :
    Injective (map (p := p) (n := n) f)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_map
statement:
theorem map_map (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    map g (map f x) = map (g.comp f) x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_shift
statement:
theorem map_shift (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    map f (shift x) = shift (map f x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_truncate
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_truncate (f : R →+* S) (x : WittVector p R) :
    map f (WittVector.truncate n x) = WittVector.truncate n (WittVector.map f x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_truncateLE
statement:
theorem map_truncateLE {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p m R) :
    map f (TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm x) = TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm (map f x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.map_verschiebung
statement:
theorem map_verschiebung (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    map f (verschiebung x) = verschiebung (map f x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.shift_injective
statement: theorem shift_injective : Injective (shift (p := p) (n := n) (R := R))

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.shift_truncate
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_truncate (x : WittVector p R) :
    shift (WittVector.truncate n x) = WittVector.truncate (n + 1) (WittVector.verschiebung x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.shift_truncate_succ
statement:
theorem shift_truncate_succ (y : TruncatedWittVector p (n + 1) R) :
    shift (TruncatedWittVector.truncate (Nat.le_succ n) y) = verschiebung y

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.subsingleton_or_charP
statement: theorem subsingleton_or_charP (hR : (p : R) = 0) : Subsingleton R ∨ CharP R p

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.truncate_shift
statement:
theorem truncate_shift (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    TruncatedWittVector.truncate (Nat.le_succ n) (shift x) = verschiebung x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.verschiebung_frobeniusFun
statement:
theorem verschiebung_frobeniusFun (hR : (p : R) = 0) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :
    verschiebung (frobeniusFun x) = (p : ℤ) • x

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.verschiebung_truncate
statement:
@[simp] theorem verschiebung_truncate (x : WittVector p R) :
    verschiebung (WittVector.truncate n x) = WittVector.truncate n (WittVector.verschiebung x)

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.verschiebung_truncateLE
statement:
theorem verschiebung_truncateLE {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p m R) :
    verschiebung (TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm x) =
      TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm (verschiebung x)

name: Deformation.coe_wittHomFrobenius
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_wittHomFrobenius (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x : TruncatedWittVector p n A) = TruncWitt.frobeniusFun x

name: Deformation.coe_wittHomMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_wittHomMap (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomMap p n φ x : TruncatedWittVector p n B) = map (φ : A →ₐ[R] B).toRingHom x

name: Deformation.coe_wittHomRestrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_wittHomRestrict {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : wittHom R p m A) :
    (wittHomRestrict R p A hm x : TruncatedWittVector p n A) =
      TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm x

name: Deformation.coe_wittHomShift
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_wittHomShift (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomShift R p n A x : TruncatedWittVector p (n + 1) A) = TruncWitt.shift x

name: Deformation.coe_wittHomVerschiebung
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_wittHomVerschiebung (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x : TruncatedWittVector p n A) = TruncWitt.verschiebung x

name: Deformation.coeff_wittHomFrobenius
statement:
theorem coeff_wittHomFrobenius (x : wittHom R p n A) (i : Fin n) :
    (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x : TruncatedWittVector p n A).coeff i =
      (x : TruncatedWittVector p n A).coeff i ^ p

name: Deformation.coeff_wittHomMap
statement:
theorem coeff_wittHomMap (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (x : wittHom R p n A) (i : Fin n) :
    (wittHomMap p n φ x : TruncatedWittVector p n B).coeff i =
      φ ((x : TruncatedWittVector p n A).coeff i)

name: Deformation.counit_coeff_of_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem counit_coeff_of_mem_wittHom {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A)
    (i : Fin n) : Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (x.coeff i) = 0

name: Deformation.frobeniusFun_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_mem_wittHom {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A) :
    TruncWitt.frobeniusFun x ∈ wittHom R p n A

name: Deformation.map_convMul_of_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem map_convMul_of_mem_wittHom {T : Type w} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A)
    (f g : WithConv (A →ₐ[R] T)) :
    map (f * g).ofConv.toRingHom x = map f.ofConv.toRingHom x + map g.ofConv.toRingHom x

name: Deformation.map_counit_of_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem map_counit_of_mem_wittHom {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A) :
    map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A).toRingHom x = 0

name: Deformation.map_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem map_mem_wittHom (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A}
    (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A) : map (φ : A →ₐ[R] B).toRingHom x ∈ wittHom R p n B

name: Deformation.mem_wittHom_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wittHom_iff (x : TruncatedWittVector p n A) :
    x ∈ wittHom R p n A ↔ map (comulRingHom R A) x =
      map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R A A).toRingHom x +
      map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R A A).toRingHom x

name: Deformation.natCast_eq_zero_of_algebra
statement: theorem natCast_eq_zero_of_algebra (B : Type w) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] : (p : B) = 0

name: Deformation.shift_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem shift_mem_wittHom {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A) :
    TruncWitt.shift x ∈ wittHom R p (n + 1) A

name: Deformation.truncateLE_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem truncateLE_mem_wittHom {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) {x : TruncatedWittVector p m A}
    (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p m A) : TruncatedWittVector.truncate hm x ∈ wittHom R p n A

name: Deformation.verschiebung_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem verschiebung_mem_wittHom {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ wittHom R p n A) :
    TruncWitt.verschiebung x ∈ wittHom R p n A

name: Deformation.wittHomDieudonneDatum_F_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wittHomDieudonneDatum_F_apply (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomDieudonneDatum R p n A).F x = wittHomFrobenius R p n A x

name: Deformation.wittHomDieudonneDatum_V_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wittHomDieudonneDatum_V_apply (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    (wittHomDieudonneDatum R p n A).V x = wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x

name: Deformation.wittHomFrobenius_verschiebung
statement:
theorem wittHomFrobenius_verschiebung (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomFrobenius R p n A (wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x) = (p : ℤ) • x

name: Deformation.wittHomMap_frobenius
statement:
theorem wittHomMap_frobenius {B : Type w} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra R B] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B)
    (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomMap p n φ (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x) = wittHomFrobenius R p n B (wittHomMap p n φ x)

name: Deformation.wittHomMap_injective
statement:
theorem wittHomMap_injective {φ : A →ₐc[R] B} (hφ : Injective φ) :
    Injective (wittHomMap p n φ)

name: Deformation.wittHomMap_restrict
statement:
theorem wittHomMap_restrict {B : Type w} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra R B] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : wittHom R p m A) :
    wittHomMap p n φ (wittHomRestrict R p A hm x) = wittHomRestrict R p B hm (wittHomMap p m φ x)

name: Deformation.wittHomMap_shift
statement:
theorem wittHomMap_shift {B : Type w} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra R B] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B)
    (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomMap p (n + 1) φ (wittHomShift R p n A x) = wittHomShift R p n B (wittHomMap p n φ x)

name: Deformation.wittHomMap_verschiebung
statement:
theorem wittHomMap_verschiebung {B : Type w} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra R B] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B)
    (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomMap p n φ (wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x) =
      wittHomVerschiebung R p n B (wittHomMap p n φ x)

name: Deformation.wittHomRestrict_frobenius
statement:
theorem wittHomRestrict_frobenius [CharP R p] {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : wittHom R p m A) :
    wittHomRestrict R p A hm (wittHomFrobenius R p m A x) =
      wittHomFrobenius R p n A (wittHomRestrict R p A hm x)

name: Deformation.wittHomRestrict_shift
statement:
theorem wittHomRestrict_shift (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomRestrict R p A (Nat.le_succ n) (wittHomShift R p n A x) = wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x

name: Deformation.wittHomRestrict_verschiebung
statement:
theorem wittHomRestrict_verschiebung {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) (x : wittHom R p m A) :
    wittHomRestrict R p A hm (wittHomVerschiebung R p m A x) =
      wittHomVerschiebung R p n A (wittHomRestrict R p A hm x)

name: Deformation.wittHomShift_frobenius
statement:
theorem wittHomShift_frobenius [CharP R p] (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomShift R p n A (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x) =
      wittHomFrobenius R p (n + 1) A (wittHomShift R p n A x)

name: Deformation.wittHomShift_injective
statement: theorem wittHomShift_injective : Injective (wittHomShift R p n A)

name: Deformation.wittHomShift_restrict
statement:
theorem wittHomShift_restrict (y : wittHom R p (n + 1) A) :
    wittHomShift R p n A (wittHomRestrict R p A (Nat.le_succ n) y) =
      wittHomVerschiebung R p (n + 1) A y

name: Deformation.wittHomShift_verschiebung
statement:
theorem wittHomShift_verschiebung (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomShift R p n A (wittHomVerschiebung R p n A x) =
      wittHomVerschiebung R p (n + 1) A (wittHomShift R p n A x)

name: Deformation.wittHomVerschiebung_frobenius
statement:
theorem wittHomVerschiebung_frobenius (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    wittHomVerschiebung R p n A (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x) = (p : ℤ) • x

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.Examples.coeff_zero_add_of_length_one
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_add_of_length_one {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (x y : TruncatedWittVector p 1 S) :
    (x + y).coeff 0 = x.coeff 0 + y.coeff 0

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.Examples.coordinate_mem_wittHom
statement:
theorem coordinate_mem_wittHom :
    TruncatedWittVector.mk p (fun _ : Fin 1 => coordinate R) ∈ wittHom R p 1 (Ga R)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.Examples.coordinate_ne_zero
statement: theorem coordinate_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : coordinate R ≠ 0

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.Examples.of_coordinate_ne_zero
statement:
theorem of_coordinate_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] :
    DieudonneModule.of R p (Ga R) 1
      ⟨TruncatedWittVector.mk p (fun _ : Fin 1 => coordinate R), coordinate_mem_wittHom R p⟩ ≠ 0

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.compat_shiftLE
statement:
theorem compat_shiftLE (g : ∀ n, wittHom R p n A →+ P)
    (hg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : wittHom R p n A), g (n + 1) (wittHomShift R p n A x) = g n x)
    (h : n ≤ m) (x : wittHom R p n A) : g m (wittHomShiftLE R p A h x) = g n x

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.dieudonneDatum_F_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dieudonneDatum_F_apply (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :
    (dieudonneDatum R p A).F z = frobenius R p A z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.dieudonneDatum_V_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dieudonneDatum_V_apply (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :
    (dieudonneDatum R p A).V z = verschiebung R p A z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.exists_of
statement: theorem exists_of (z : DieudonneModule R p A) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : wittHom R p n A), of R p A n x = z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.exists_pow_nsmul_eq_zero
statement: theorem exists_pow_nsmul_eq_zero (z : DieudonneModule R p A) : ∃ n : ℕ, p ^ n • z = 0

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.exists_shiftLE_eq_zero_of_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_shiftLE_eq_zero_of_of_eq_zero {x : wittHom R p n A} (hx : of R p A n x = 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m), wittHomShiftLE R p A h x = 0

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.frobenius_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem frobenius_of (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    frobenius R p A (of R p A n x) = of R p A n (wittHomFrobenius R p n A x)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.frobenius_verschiebung
statement:
theorem frobenius_verschiebung (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :
    frobenius R p A (verschiebung R p A z) = (p : ℤ) • z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : DieudonneModule R p A →+ P}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : wittHom R p n A), f (of R p A n x) = g (of R p A n x)) : f = g

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on {C : DieudonneModule R p A → Prop} (z : DieudonneModule R p A)
    (ih : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : wittHom R p n A), C (of R p A n x)) : C z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.lift_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_of (g : ∀ n, wittHom R p n A →+ P)
    (hg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : wittHom R p n A), g (n + 1) (wittHomShift R p n A x) = g n x)
    (x : wittHom R p n A) : lift R p A g hg (of R p A n x) = g n x

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {C : Type*} [CommRing C] [Bialgebra R C] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (ψ : B →ₐc[R] C)
    (z : DieudonneModule R p A) : map R p (ψ.comp φ) z = map R p ψ (map R p φ z)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_frobenius
statement:
theorem map_frobenius [CharP R p] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :
    map R p φ (frobenius R p A z) = frobenius R p B (map R p φ z)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_id
statement: theorem map_id (z : DieudonneModule R p A) : map R p (BialgHom.id R A) z = z

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective {φ : A →ₐc[R] B} (hφ : Injective φ) : Injective (map R p φ)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_of (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (x : wittHom R p n A) :
    map R p φ (of R p A n x) = of R p B n (wittHomMap p n φ x)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_verschiebung
statement:
theorem map_verschiebung (φ : A →ₐc[R] B) (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :
    map R p φ (verschiebung R p A z) = verschiebung R p B (map R p φ z)

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.of_eq_of_iff
statement:
theorem of_eq_of_iff (x : wittHom R p n A) (y : wittHom R p m A) :
    of R p A n x = of R p A m y ↔

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_shiftLE
statement:
theorem coeff_shiftLE (h : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin m) :

      if hi : m - n ≤ (i : ℕ) then x.coeff ⟨i - (m - n), by omega⟩ else 0

theorem coeff_shiftLE_add (h : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin n) :

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_shiftLE

theorem frobeniusFun_shiftLE (h : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :

statement:
theorem mem_fontaineKer_iff_forall (hπ : RingHom.ker π ≤ Ideal.span {(p : ℛ)}) (hπs : Surjective π)

theorem mem_fontaineKer_of_shift_mem (hp' : (p : ℛ) ∈ nonZeroDivisors ℛ)

theorem shiftLE_mem_fontaineKer_iff (hp' : (p : ℛ) ∈ nonZeroDivisors ℛ)
    (hπ : RingHom.ker π ≤ Ideal.span {(p : ℛ)}) (hπs : Surjective π) {m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (a : TruncatedWittVector p n A) :
    shiftLE h a ∈ fontaineKer p m π ↔ a ∈ fontaineKer p n π

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.shift_mem_fontaineKer

theorem ghostComponent_map {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : ℛ →+* S) (n : ℕ) (X : WittVector p ℛ) :

theorem eval_comp_bialgHom {B : Type u'} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra R B] (φ : A →ₐc[R] B)

theorem eval_convMul (f g : WithConv (A →ₐ[R] T)) (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :

theorem eval_convOne (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.eval_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_of (f : A →ₐ[R] T) (x : wittHom R p n A) :

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.eval_verschiebung

theorem eval_verschiebung (f : A →ₐ[R] T) (z : DieudonneModule R p A) :

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_comp_eval

name: Deformation.DieudonneModule.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval {T' : Type u'} [CommRing T'] [Algebra R T'] (g : T →ₐ[R] T') (f : A →ₐ[R] T)

statement:
theorem compat_shiftLE (g : ∀ n, TruncatedWittVector p n S →+ P)
    (hg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S), g (n + 1) (TruncWitt.shift x) = g n x)
    (h : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) : g m (TruncWitt.shiftLE h x) = g n x

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.dieudonneDatum_F_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dieudonneDatum_F_apply (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    (dieudonneDatum R p S).F z = frobenius R p S z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.dieudonneDatum_V_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dieudonneDatum_V_apply (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    (dieudonneDatum R p S).V z = verschiebung p S z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.exists_of
statement:
theorem exists_of (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S), of p S n x = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.exists_of_eq_of_verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_eq_of_verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero {z : UnipotentWittCovector p S}
    (hz : (verschiebung p S)^[n] z = 0) : ∃ x : TruncatedWittVector p n S, of p S n x = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.exists_pow_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_nsmul_eq_zero (hS : (p : S) = 0) (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, p ^ n • z = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.exists_shiftLE_eq_zero_of_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_shiftLE_eq_zero_of_of_eq_zero {x : TruncatedWittVector p n S} (hx : of p S n x = 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m), TruncWitt.shiftLE h x = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.exists_verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (verschiebung p S)^[n] z = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.frobenius_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem frobenius_of (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :
    frobenius R p S (of p S n x) = of p S n (TruncWitt.frobeniusFun x)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.frobenius_verschiebung
statement:
theorem frobenius_verschiebung (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    frobenius R p S (verschiebung p S z) = (p : ℤ) • z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.frobenius_verschiebung_comm
statement:
theorem frobenius_verschiebung_comm (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    frobenius R p S (verschiebung p S z) = verschiebung p S (frobenius R p S z)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : UnipotentWittCovector p S →+ P}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S), f (of p S n x) = g (of p S n x)) : f = g

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on {C : UnipotentWittCovector p S → Prop} (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S)
    (ih : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S), C (of p S n x)) : C z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.lift_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_of (g : ∀ n, TruncatedWittVector p n S →+ P)
    (hg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S), g (n + 1) (TruncWitt.shift x) = g n x)
    (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) : lift p S g hg (of p S n x) = g n x

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : S →+* T) (g : T →+* U) :
    (map p g).comp (map p f) = map p (g.comp f)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_frobenius
statement:
theorem map_frobenius {T : Type w} [CommRing T] (R' : Type u') [CommRing R'] [CharP R' p]
    [Algebra R' T] (f : S →+* T) (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    map p f (frobenius R p S z) = frobenius R' p T (map p f z)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_id
statement: theorem map_id (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) : map p (RingHom.id S) z = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective {f : S →+* T} (hf : Injective f) : Injective (map p f)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_map
statement:
theorem map_map (f : S →+* T) (g : T →+* U) (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    map p g (map p f z) = map p (g.comp f) z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_mem_wKer
statement:
theorem map_mem_wKer {ℛ' : Type w} [CommRing ℛ'] {A' : Type u'} [CommRing A']
    (f : ℛ →+* ℛ') (g : A →+* A') (π' : ℛ' →+* A') (hcomm : π'.comp f = g.comp π)
    {z : UnipotentWittCovector p A} (hz : z ∈ wKer p π) : map p g z ∈ wKer p π'

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_of (f : S →+* T) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :
    map p f (of p S n x) = of p T n (TruncWitt.map f x)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_verschiebung
statement:
theorem map_verschiebung (f : S →+* T) (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    map p f (verschiebung p S z) = verschiebung p T (map p f z)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.map_wKer_le
statement:
theorem map_wKer_le {ℛ' : Type w} [CommRing ℛ'] {A' : Type u'} [CommRing A']
    (f : ℛ →+* ℛ') (g : A →+* A') (π' : ℛ' →+* A') (hcomm : π'.comp f = g.comp π) :
    (wKer p π).map (map p g) ≤ wKer p π'

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.mem_wKer_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wKer_iff (z : UnipotentWittCovector p A) :
    z ∈ wKer p π ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n A),
      x ∈ TruncWitt.fontaineKer p n π ∧ of p A n x = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_eq_of_iff
statement:
theorem of_eq_of_iff (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) (y : TruncatedWittVector p m S) :
    of p S n x = of p S m y ↔
      TruncWitt.shiftLE (le_max_left n m) x = TruncWitt.shiftLE (le_max_right n m) y

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_injective
statement: theorem of_injective (n : ℕ) : Injective (of p S n)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_mem_wKer
statement:
theorem of_mem_wKer {x : TruncatedWittVector p n A} (hx : x ∈ TruncWitt.fontaineKer p n π) :
    of p A n x ∈ wKer p π

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_mem_wKer_iff
statement:
theorem of_mem_wKer_iff (hp' : (p : ℛ) ∈ nonZeroDivisors ℛ)
    (hπ : RingHom.ker π ≤ Ideal.span {(p : ℛ)}) (hπs : Surjective π) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n A) :
    of p A n x ∈ wKer p π ↔ x ∈ TruncWitt.fontaineKer p n π

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem of_shift (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :
    of p S (n + 1) (TruncWitt.shift x) = of p S n x

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_shiftLE
statement:
@[simp] theorem of_shiftLE (h : n ≤ m) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.of_zero_eq_zero
statement: theorem of_zero_eq_zero (x : TruncatedWittVector p 0 S) : of p S 0 x = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.pow_nsmul_of
statement: theorem pow_nsmul_of (hS : (p : S) = 0) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) : p ^ n • of p S n x = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem verschiebung_eq_zero_iff (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    verschiebung p S z = 0 ↔ ∃ x : TruncatedWittVector p 1 S, of p S 1 x = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_frobenius
statement:
theorem verschiebung_frobenius (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    verschiebung p S (frobenius R p S z) = (p : ℤ) • z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem verschiebung_iterate_eq_zero_iff (z : UnipotentWittCovector p S) :
    (verschiebung p S)^[n] z = 0 ↔ ∃ x : TruncatedWittVector p n S, of p S n x = z

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_iterate_of
statement:
theorem verschiebung_iterate_of (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :
    (verschiebung p S)^[n] (of p S n x) = 0

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_iterate_of_le
statement:
theorem verschiebung_iterate_of_le (h : n ≤ m) (y : TruncatedWittVector p m S) :
    (verschiebung p S)^[m - n] (of p S m y) = of p S n (TruncatedWittVector.truncate h y)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem verschiebung_of (x : TruncatedWittVector p n S) :
    verschiebung p S (of p S n x) = of p S n (TruncWitt.verschiebung x)

name: Deformation.UnipotentWittCovector.verschiebung_of_succ
statement:
theorem verschiebung_of_succ (y : TruncatedWittVector p (n + 1) S) :
    verschiebung p S (of p S (n + 1) y) =
      of p S n (TruncatedWittVector.truncate (Nat.le_succ n) y)

name: Deformation.WittGroup.antipode_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem antipode_X (j : J) (i : Fin n) :

name: Deformation.WittGroup.antipode_def

theorem antipode_lTensor_comul :

      (Algebra.ofId R (Coord R p n J)).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (Coord R p n J))

name: Deformation.WittGroup.antipode_rTensor_comul
statement:
theorem antipode_rTensor_comul :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (antipode R p n J) (AlgHom.id R (Coord R p n J))
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)).comp (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R (Coord R p n J)) =
      (Algebra.ofId R (Coord R p n J)).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (Coord R p n J))

name: Deformation.WittGroup.coe_univHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_univHom (j : J) : (univHom (R := R) (p := p) (n := n) j : TruncatedWittVector p n (Coord R p n J)) =
    univ R p n j

name: Deformation.WittGroup.coeff_pointsEquiv
statement:
theorem coeff_pointsEquiv (φ : Coord R p n J →ₐ[R] A) (j : J) (i : Fin n) :
    (pointsEquiv φ j).coeff i = φ (X j i)

name: Deformation.WittGroup.coeff_univ
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_univ (j : J) (i : Fin n) : (univ R p n j).coeff i = X j i

name: Deformation.WittGroup.comulAlgHom_eq
statement: theorem comulAlgHom_eq : Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R (Coord R p n J) = comul R p n J

name: Deformation.WittGroup.comul_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem comul_X (j : J) (i : Fin n) :

name: Deformation.WittGroup.comul_coassoc
statement:
theorem comul_coassoc :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc R R R 𝒪 𝒪 𝒪).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (comul R p n J) (AlgHom.id R 𝒪)).comp (comul R p n J)) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R 𝒪) (comul R p n J)).comp (comul R p n J)

name: Deformation.WittGroup.comul_def
statement: theorem comul_def (x : Coord R p n J) : Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x = comul R p n J x

statement:
theorem comul_lTensor_counit :

      (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid R R 𝒪).symm

name: Deformation.WittGroup.comul_rTensor_counit
statement:
theorem comul_rTensor_counit :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (counit R p n J) (AlgHom.id R 𝒪)).comp (comul R p n J) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R 𝒪).symm

name: Deformation.WittGroup.counitAlgHom_eq
statement: theorem counitAlgHom_eq : Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (Coord R p n J) = counit R p n J

name: Deformation.WittGroup.counit_def

statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_X {A : Type w} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] (f : J → Fin n → A) (j : J)

name: Deformation.WittGroup.map_mk
statement:
theorem map_mk (g : S →+* T) (f : Fin n → S) :

name: Deformation.WittGroup.map_univ
statement:
theorem map_univ {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : Coord R p n J →+* B) (j : J) :
    TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ R p n j) = TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (X j i)

name: Deformation.WittGroup.mk_ringHom_antipode
statement:
theorem mk_ringHom_antipode {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : Coord R p n J →+* B) (j : J) :
    (TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (antipode R p n J (X j i))) =
      -(TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (X j i))

name: Deformation.WittGroup.mk_ringHom_comul
statement:
theorem mk_ringHom_comul {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : Coord R p n J ⊗[R] Coord R p n J →+* B)
    (j : J) :
    (TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (comul R p n J (X j i))) =
      (TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (X j i ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Coord R p n J))) +
        (TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g ((1 : Coord R p n J) ⊗ₜ[R] X j i))

name: Deformation.WittGroup.mk_zero_eq
statement: theorem mk_zero_eq : (TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun _ : Fin n => (0 : S)) = 0

name: Deformation.WittGroup.pointsEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem pointsEquiv_apply (φ : Coord R p n J →ₐ[R] A) (j : J) :

name: Deformation.WittGroup.pointsEquiv_comp_antipode
statement:
theorem pointsEquiv_comp_antipode (φ : Coord R p n J →ₐ[R] A) :

statement:

statement:
theorem pointsEquiv_mul (φ ψ : WithConv (Coord R p n J →ₐ[R] A)) :

name: Deformation.WittGroup.pointsEquiv_one
statement: theorem pointsEquiv_one : pointsEquiv (1 : WithConv (Coord R p n J →ₐ[R] A)).ofConv = 0

name: Deformation.WittGroup.pointsEquiv_symm_apply_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointsEquiv_symm_apply_X (x : J → TruncatedWittVector p n A) (j : J) (i : Fin n) :
    pointsEquiv.symm x (X j i : Coord R p n J) = (x j).coeff i

name: Deformation.WittGroup.rehom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rehom_apply (g : S → B) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (hm : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (ha : ∀ x y, g (x + y) = g x + g y) (x : S) : rehom g h1 hm h0 ha x = g x

name: Deformation.WittGroup.ringHom_antipode_X
statement:
theorem ringHom_antipode_X {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : Coord R p n J →+* B) (j : J) (i : Fin n) :

statement:
theorem ringHom_comul_X {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : Coord R p n J ⊗[R] Coord R p n J →+* B)

    g (comul R p n J (X j i)) =
      ((TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g (X j i ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Coord R p n J))) +

statement: theorem univ_mem_wittHom (j : J) : univ R p n j ∈ wittHom R p n (Coord R p n J)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.comul_mk

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.counitAlgHom_eq
statement: theorem counitAlgHom_eq : counitAlgHom R (H ⧸ I) = counit R I

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.counit_mk
statement:

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.hopf_antipode_mk

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.mul_antipode_rTensor_comul

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfIdealQuotient.rTensor_counit_comul
statement:
theorem rTensor_counit_comul :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (counit R I) (.id R (H ⧸ I))).comp (comul R I) =

name: HopfAlgebra.convMul_comp_antipodeAlgHom

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.coeff_frobeniusFun_iterate

theorem frobeniusFun_iterate_add (hR : (p : R) = 0) (c : ℕ) (x y : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :

statement:
theorem frobeniusFun_iterate_mk (c : ℕ) (g : Fin n → R) :
    frobeniusFun^[c] (TruncatedWittVector.mk p g) = TruncatedWittVector.mk p fun i => g i ^ p ^ c

name: Deformation.TruncWitt.frobeniusFun_iterate_neg

theorem frobeniusFun_iterate_neg (hR : (p : R) = 0) (c : ℕ) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) :

name: Deformation.WittKernel.coe_tauto
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_tauto (j : J) :
    (tauto k p n a b J j : TruncatedWittVector p n (Coord k p n a b J)) =
      TruncWitt.map (p := p) (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ideal k p n a b J)) (univ k p n j)

name: Deformation.WittKernel.coeff_tauto
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_tauto (j : J) (i : Fin n) :
    (tauto k p n a b J j : TruncatedWittVector p n (Coord k p n a b J)).coeff i =
      π k p n a b J (X j i)

      (wittHomFrobenius k p n (Coord k p n a b J))^[a] (tauto k p n a b J j)

name: Deformation.WittKernel.ideal_le_iff
statement:
theorem ideal_le_iff {I : Ideal (WittGroup.Coord k p n J)} :
    ideal k p n a b J ≤ I ↔ ∀ j i, relation k p n a b J j i ∈ I

name: Deformation.WittKernel.ideal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem ideal_le_ker_iff {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : WittGroup.Coord k p n J →+* B) :
    ideal k p n a b J ≤ RingHom.ker g ↔
      ∀ j, frobeniusFun^[b] (TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ k p n j)) =
        frobeniusFun^[a] (TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ k p n j))

statement: theorem relation_mem_ideal (j : J) (i : Fin n) : relation k p n a b J j i ∈ ideal k p n a b J

name: Deformation.WittKernel.ringHom_X_pow
statement:
theorem ringHom_X_pow {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : WittGroup.Coord k p n J →+* B) (j : J)
    (i : Fin n) (c : ℕ) :
    g (X j i) ^ p ^ c = (frobeniusFun^[c] (TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ k p n j))).coeff i

name: Deformation.WittKernel.ringHom_relation
statement:
theorem ringHom_relation {B : Type w} [CommRing B] (g : WittGroup.Coord k p n J →+* B) (j : J)
    (i : Fin n) :
    g (relation k p n a b J j i) =
      (frobeniusFun^[b] (TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ k p n j))).coeff i -
        (frobeniusFun^[a] (TruncWitt.map (p := p) g (univ k p n j))).coeff i

        ((p.2 : (GaloisField q 2)ˣ) : GaloisField q 2) ^ (q + 1)

name: groupCohomology.finrank_selmer_le_of_isGreenbergWilesDatum
statement:
theorem finrank_selmer_le_of_isGreenbergWilesDatum
    {L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M))}
    (h : IsGreenbergWilesDatum loc M M' pairing L) :
    finrank k (selmer loc M L)
      ≤ finrank k (selmer loc M' (dualConditions loc M M' pairing L))
        + finrank k M.ρ.invariants + ∑ v, finrank k (L v)

name: groupCohomology.mem_orthogonal_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_orthogonal_iff {V W : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module k W] (B : V →ₗ[k] W →ₗ[k] k) (L : Submodule k V) (w : W) :
    w ∈ orthogonal B L ↔ ∀ x ∈ L, B x w = 0

name: groupCohomology.orthogonal_anti

    orthogonal B L' ≤ orthogonal B L

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.corrOff_def
statement:
theorem corrOff_def (χϖ : ℂ) (N : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (s : ℂ) :
    corrOff χϖ N e s = if e ≤ 0 then geomSum χϖ N (-e).toNat s else 0

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.corrOff_differentiable
statement:
theorem corrOff_differentiable (χϖ : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (e : ℤ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (corrOff χϖ N e)

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.corrOn_def
statement:
theorem corrOn_def (N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (c m : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (μ𝒪 : ℝ) (c₀ : ℂ) (sh : ℕ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) :
    corrOn N n c m e μ𝒪 c₀ sh s =
      if e ≤ n + (max m c : ℕ) then (μ𝒪 : ℂ)⁻¹ * ramSum N (max ((m : ℤ) - 1) (n + (c : ℤ) - e)).toNat c₀ sh s
      else 0

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.corrOn_differentiable
statement:
theorem corrOn_differentiable {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (n : ℤ) (c m : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (μ𝒪 : ℝ) (c₀ : ℂ)
    (sh : ℕ → ℂ) : Differentiable ℂ (corrOn N n c m e μ𝒪 c₀ sh)

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.differentiable_cpow_neg_two_mul
statement:
theorem differentiable_cpow_neg_two_mul {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.differentiable_cpow_neg_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem differentiable_cpow_neg_two_mul_add_one {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Differentiable ℂ (fun s : ℂ => ((N : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-(2 * s + 1)))

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.geomSum_def
statement:
theorem geomSum_def (χϖ : ℂ) (N M : ℕ) (s : ℂ) :
    geomSum χϖ N M s = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (χϖ * ((N : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-(2 * s))) ^ k

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.geomSum_differentiable
statement:
theorem geomSum_differentiable (χϖ : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (M : ℕ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (geomSum χϖ N M)

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.ramSum_def
statement:
theorem ramSum_def (N K : ℕ) (c₀ : ℂ) (sh : ℕ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) :
    ramSum N K c₀ sh s = c₀ + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, (((N : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-(2 * s + 1))) ^ k * sh k

name: EisensteinGeneral.LocalCorrection.ramSum_differentiable
statement:
theorem ramSum_differentiable {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (K : ℕ) (c₀ : ℂ) (sh : ℕ → ℂ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (ramSum N K c₀ sh)

theorem coeffCoboundaryMap_apply (ρ : Representation K G V) (v : V) (g : G) :
    coeffCoboundaryMap ρ v g = ρ g v - v

name: HeckeEis.coeffH1parMk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem coeffH1parMk_eq_zero_iff (ρ : Representation K Γ V) (z : ↥(coeffParabolicCocycles ρ)) :
    coeffH1parMk ρ z = 0 ↔ (z : Γ → V) ∈ coeffCoboundaries ρ

name: HeckeEis.coeffH1parMk_surjective
statement:
theorem coeffH1parMk_surjective (ρ : Representation K Γ V) :
    Function.Surjective (coeffH1parMk ρ)

name: HeckeEis.coeffHeckeFun_apply
statement:
theorem coeffHeckeFun_apply (ρ : Representation K (Gamma0 N) V) (a : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (z : Gamma0 N → V) (g : Gamma0 N) :
    coeffHeckeFun N ℓ ρ a z g =
      letI

name: HeckeEis.coeffHeckeFun_trivial
statement:
theorem coeffHeckeFun_trivial (φ : Additive (Gamma0 N) →+ K) (g : Gamma0 N) :
    coeffHeckeFun N ℓ (1 : Representation K (Gamma0 N) K) LinearMap.id
        (fun h => φ (Additive.ofMul h)) g
      = heckeOperatorHom N ℓ K φ (Additive.ofMul g)

name: HeckeEis.coeffParabolicCocycles_le_coeffCocycles
statement:
theorem coeffParabolicCocycles_le_coeffCocycles (ρ : Representation K Γ V) :
    coeffParabolicCocycles ρ ≤ coeffCocycles ρ

name: HeckeEis.mem_coeffCoboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coeffCoboundaries_iff (ρ : Representation K G V) (z : G → V) :
    z ∈ coeffCoboundaries ρ ↔ ∃ v : V, (fun g => ρ g v - v) = z

name: HeckeEis.mem_coeffCocycles_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coeffCocycles_iff (ρ : Representation K G V) (z : G → V) :
    z ∈ coeffCocycles ρ ↔ ∀ g h : G, z (g * h) = z g + ρ g (z h)

name: HeckeEis.mem_coeffParabolicCocycles_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coeffParabolicCocycles_iff (ρ : Representation K Γ V) (z : Γ → V) :
    z ∈ coeffParabolicCocycles ρ ↔ z ∈ coeffCocycles ρ ∧ IsParabolicCocycle ρ z

name: ModularCurve.IsUnimodularRow.map

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.map_mk

name: ModularCurve.isUnimodularRow_one_right

statement: theorem isUnit_det_redMat_coe (N : ℕ) (g : SL(2, ℤ)) : IsUnit (redMat N (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)).det

name: HeckeEis.projLineAct_coe_mul

    projLineAct N ((g * h : SL(2, ℤ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) P

name: HeckeEis.projLineAct_mul

theorem projLineAct_mul (N : ℕ) (M M' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)
    (hM : IsUnit (redMat N M).det) (hM' : IsUnit (redMat N M').det) (P : ProjectiveLine (ZMod N)) :
    projLineAct N (M * M') P = projLineAct N M' (projLineAct N M P)

name: HeckeEis.projLineAct_of_isUnit

theorem projLineAct_of_isUnit (N : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) (h : IsUnit (redMat N M).det) :

name: HeckeEis.projLineAct_one

theorem projLineRep_apply (g : CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 1) (f : ProjectiveLine (ZMod N) → K)

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.vecMulRow_fst
statement:

theorem vecMulRow_fst (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (hM : IsUnit M.det) (v : UnimodularRow R) :
    (vecMulRow M hM v).1.1 = v.1.1 * M 0 0 + v.1.2 * M 1 0

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.vecMulRow_snd
statement:

theorem vecMulRow_snd (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (hM : IsUnit M.det) (v : UnimodularRow R) :

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.vecMul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vecMul_mk (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (hM : IsUnit M.det) (v : UnimodularRow R) :

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.vecMul_mul
statement:
theorem vecMul_mul (M M' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (hM : IsUnit M.det) (hM' : IsUnit M'.det)
    (hMM' : IsUnit (M * M').det) (P : ProjectiveLine R) :
    vecMul (M * M') hMM' P = vecMul M' hM' (vecMul M hM P)

name: ModularCurve.ProjectiveLine.vecMul_one
statement:
theorem vecMul_one (h : IsUnit (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R).det) (P : ProjectiveLine R) :

theorem binarySubst_mul (M M' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) :

name: HeckeEis.binarySubst_one

    (h1 : (u : ZMod p) * v.1.1 = w.1.1) (h2 : (u : ZMod p) * v.1.2 = w.1.2) :

name: groupCohomology.cochainCup_apply
statement:
theorem cochainCup_apply (f : (Fin p → G) → A) (g : (Fin q → G) → B) (σ : Fin (p + q) → G) :
    cochainCup A B p q f g σ
      = f (cochainCupFst p q σ) ⊗ₜ[k] B.ρ (Fin.partialProd (cochainCupFst p q σ) (Fin.last p)) (g (cochainCupSnd p q σ))

name: groupCohomology.eq_continuousH1_of_forall_mem_iff
statement:
lemma eq_continuousH1_of_forall_mem_iff (adm₁ : Submodule k (H1 M))
    (hadm₁ : ∀ x, x ∈ adm₁ ↔ ∃ c : cocycles₁ M,
      (∃ F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F ∧
        ∀ (g s : G), r s ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → c.val (g * s) = c.val g)
      ∧ (H1π M).hom c = x) :
    adm₁ = continuousH1 r M

lemma mem_continuousH1_iff (x : H1 M) :

      (u (fun i => (τ.lam ((τ.σ q)⁻¹ * Fin.partialProd g (Fin.castSucc i)))⁻¹
                     * τ.lam ((τ.σ q)⁻¹ * Fin.partialProd g i.succ)))
